classes.FINITE_WINDOW: Direct arithmetic contamination ends after the bad observation exits the eligible-session window.
classes.RECURSIVE_IIR: State error decays geometrically but does not become exactly zero after a fixed number of bars.
classes.CUMULATIVE: Absolute level retains historical shocks until recomputed/rebased/windowed.
classes.PATH_STATE: A bad event can alter later state transitions; contamination is not described by one geometric decay.

certificationRules.FINITE_WINDOW: Use exact clean eligible-session window with canonical continuity semantics.
certificationRules.RECURSIVE_IIR: Prefer full recomputation from corrected history or trusted prior state; arbitrary wait-N is insufficient.
certificationRules.CUMULATIVE: Recompute/rebase or use bounded windowed representation.
certificationRules.PATH_STATE: Replay state machine from trusted pre-boundary state or complete corrected history.

prohibitedUses: Do not convert half-life diagnostics into production thresholds.
Do not declare state clean merely because one half-life or one nominal lookback elapsed.
Do not count suspension calendar days as eligible bars.
